snippet.title: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown - Official Overview Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a closer look at Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown in this new trailer for the upcoming sci-fi combat racing game inspired by retro arcade racers. Race across vibrant alien worlds, defeat opponents in destruction-rich environments, and become the Cosmic Champion. Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
